subject.title: [Bug]: ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME} is not process when installing a skill

question: Should OpenClaw expand `$VAR` and `${VAR}` inside shared user/workspace path resolvers, or keep env interpolation limited to config loading and dotenv handling?
rationale: The bug is source-proven, but the direct fix changes a shared path interpretation rule that can affect existing stored paths, plugin behavior, and workspace resolution.

options.title: Adopt shared path expansion
options.body: Expand known env placeholders in shared path helpers, preserve or document literal/unknown behavior, and require focused resolver plus skill-install tests before merge.

options.title: Limit expansion to config load
options.body: Keep path helpers literal and normalize authored config paths before runtime callers receive them, avoiding a broader path-helper contract change.

options.title: Defer to dotenv policy
options.body: Leave this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/38259 settles the broader env-expansion policy across config and dotenv sources.

recommendation.title: Adopt shared path expansion
recommendation.body: Expand known env placeholders in shared path helpers, preserve or document literal/unknown behavior, and require focused resolver plus skill-install tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent history on the shared resolver semantics and cleanup commits that this decision would modify.
